verdict.rationale: Floot documents exporting the full TypeScript/React project and database for self-hosting (floot-docs-11, floot-docs-33), which gives some code ownership, but there is no evidence of a mechanism to edit locally and push changes back into the Floot platform (no CLI, git sync, or import path is documented). missing for 10: a documented push/import path for local edits, CLI or git-based sync tooling, evidence of round-trip workflow rather than one-way export.
